impact: `_pdf_semantic_evidence` is 54 lines and combines two external extraction commands with tag discovery, header counting, sentinel ordering, caption ownership, structure-tree text ownership, and construction of six check results. Adding a semantic invariant or changing extraction transport requires modifying unrelated acquisition and evaluation logic together. I read the full function and grepped its wrapper and attestation callers; only the caption text traversal is delegated.
